LOOK: Various climate advocates staged a protest in front of the Japanese Embassy on Tuesday, June 17, ahead of the Japan Energy Summit, which is set to take place from June 18 to 20 in Tokyo.

The groups say Japan’s reliance on fossil fuels and support for false solutions are harming the climate and putting communities across Asia at risk. (Contributed photos)
